description: This file contains test helper functions and registry setup for command authorization, specifically for Discord and WhatsApp plugins, including functions to format and normalize allow-from entries and hooks to install registry configurations before and after tests.

methods.name: formatDiscordAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Formats Discord allow-from entries by cleaning and converting them to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizePhoneAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Normalizes phone allow-from entries, handling special cases and converting to E.164 format.

methods.name: resolveChannelAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves the allowFrom configuration for a specific channel from a given config object.
